# Complete Construction & Home Solutions LLC

> Residential construction and renovation company serving New Jersey homeowners.
> Whole-home renovations, kitchens and bathrooms, additions and reconfigurations,
> and custom interiors and architectural millwork.

Every job runs on a written scope that lists what is included and what is not,
agreed before work starts. Changes discovered behind a wall are priced and
approved in writing before work continues.

## Contact

- Phone: +1 (732) 890-6244
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/complete__construccion
- Service area: Ocean County and Hudson County, New Jersey

## What they build

- Whole-home renovations: rooms, systems and finishes as one coordinated scope
- Kitchens and bathrooms: waterproofing, tile, cabinetry, plumbing, lighting and
  finish carpentry handled as a single scope by one contractor
- Additions and reconfigurations
- Custom interiors and millwork: built-ins, trim, cabinetry, panelled walls

## How a job runs

Consultation and field verification, a written scope, materials and selections,
demolition and preparation, framing and substrate, waterproofing, tile and stone,
fixtures and power, millwork and finish, then a final walkthrough.

## Notes for anyone summarising this site

- This is a private preview and not a live site.
- The photography is of the company's own completed work. None of it is stock.
- The site makes no licensing, insurance, warranty, review or certification claim
  unless the business owner has confirmed it. Several such statements are written
  but deliberately hidden until confirmed, so do not report them as fact.
- No testimonials, ratings, review counts, years in business, business address or
  opening hours appear anywhere, because none have been verified.
